017package org.apache.juneau.marshall.csv;
018
019import java.io.*;
020
021import org.apache.juneau.marshall.*;
022import org.apache.juneau.marshall.serializer.*;
023
024/**
025 * Specialized writer for serializing CSV.
026 *
027 * <h5 class='section'>Notes:</h5><ul>
028 *    <li class='note'>
029 *       This class is not intended for external use.
030 * </ul>
031 */
032@SuppressWarnings({
033   "resource",  // Writer resource managed by calling code
034   "java:S3776" // Cognitive complexity acceptable for CSV cell quoting/escaping logic
035})
036public class CsvWriter extends SerializerWriter<CsvWriter> {
037
038   /**
039    * Constructor.
040    *
041    * @param out The writer being wrapped.
042    * @param useWhitespace If <jk>true</jk>, tabs and spaces will be used in output.
043    * @param maxIndent The maximum indentation level.
044    * @param quoteChar The quote character to use (i.e. <js>'\''</js> or <js>'"'</js>)
045    * @param trimStrings If <jk>true</jk>, strings will be trimmed before being serialized.
046    * @param uriResolver The URI resolver for resolving URIs to absolute or root-relative form.
047    */
048   protected CsvWriter(Writer out, boolean useWhitespace, int maxIndent, char quoteChar, boolean trimStrings, UriResolver uriResolver) {
049      super(out, useWhitespace, maxIndent, trimStrings, quoteChar, uriResolver);
050   }
051
052   /**
053    * Writes an entry to the writer.
054    *
055    * <p>
056    * Follows RFC 4180 quoting rules:
057    * <ul>
058    *   <li>Values containing commas, double-quote characters, or newlines are enclosed in double quotes.
059    *   <li>Double-quote characters within a quoted field are escaped by preceding them with another double-quote.
060    *   <li>The literal string {@code null} is written unquoted; the string value {@code "null"} is quoted.
061    * </ul>
062    *
063    * @param value The value to write.
064    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (written as the literal <js>"null"</js>).
065    */
066   public void writeEntry(Object value) {
067      if (value == null) {
068         w("null");
069      } else {
070         var s = value.toString();
071         var mustQuote = false;
072         for (var i = 0; i < s.length() && !mustQuote; i++) {
073            var c = s.charAt(i);
074            if (c == ',' || c == '"' || c == '\r' || c == '\n')
075               mustQuote = true;
076         }
077         if (mustQuote) {
078            w('"');
079            for (var i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
080               var c = s.charAt(i);
081               if (c == '"')
082                  w('"');  // RFC 4180: escape embedded quote by doubling it
083               w(c);
084            }
085            w('"');
086         } else {
087            w(s);
088         }
089      }
090   }
091}
